stock.pack_missing: The pack mass is unknown: the stock is counted in pieces and food eaten in grams is not taken from it.
stock.pack_needed_hint: This product is stocked in pieces without a pack mass, so {} were not taken from stock. Enter the mass of one pack: the stock is recalculated and what you ate is written off.
stock.receipt_target_hint: Food products from the receipt go to the chosen store. The default comes from Settings.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.device_on: System notifications are on for this device.
notify.device_off: System notifications are off on this device — new notifications appear only in the list.
notify.device_denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser or device settings. Allow them to receive push.
notify.device_unsupported: This device does not support system notifications — check the list in the app.
notify.device_server_off: Push is not configured on the server (VAPID keys). Notifications are available in the list.
notify.kind_plan_hint: A reminder before an event starts
notify.kind_workout_hint: A reminder before a scheduled workout
notify.kind_expiring_hint: At 9:00 the day before the last day — “Expires tomorrow”
notify.kind_expired_hint: When the rest of an expired lot goes to waste
notify.tz_hint: Time zone for reminders and expiry dates: {}

people.view_only_hint: View only: you can change your own data and your children's data if you own or administer the group.

energy.title: Calorie balance
energy.empty: No data for this day yet.
energy.hint: The balance accumulates and does not reset at midnight. Food raises the line, calories burn evenly at maintenance level, workouts burn extra. Tap the chart to set the exact value at that time; tap a name to hide its line.
energy.correct_hint: From this moment the chart continues from the value you enter. A negative number is a deficit.
